auditMethod: candidate JSON versus fixed Gold JSON under benchmarks/paper-import/SCORING-PROTOCOL.md; semantic equivalence reviewed by Codex

reasons: The candidate has excellent object and hypothesis coverage: it recovers the parameterized triple module, boundary algebra and module actions, evaluation bridge, Khovanov tangle comparison, the general gluing theorem, and the handle-attachment consequences.
The selected main target paper:theorem:4.1 is semantically equivalent to the Gold general gluing isomorphism and is the strongest new theorem rather than a summary or historical special case.

The B0 contains correctly sourced semantic equivalents of the Gold evaluation isomorphism, Khovanov tangle functor, and Ren-Willis gluing surjection, with no historical handle formulas misclassified as active B0. The separate Gold MWW skein-lasagna foundation is not represented as its own fourth B0 Claim.

The proof graph correctly directs the external evaluation and Khovanov inputs into the comparison lemmas, the gluing-surjection boundary into Theorem 4.1, and Theorem 4.1 into the handle formulas. Some proof dependencies remain summarized rather than decomposed as fully as the Gold.

The final graph is acyclic and executable. One non-core generalization Claim remains open, and each assembly pass required the same three deterministic removals of invalid organization/self-premise edges, so the result does not receive full structure or claim-state credit.
